test_title: PYST 5: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question:
Study the following line graph carefully and answer the question below.

Given graph represents marks obtained by Riya and Rida in six subjects of 12th exam of CBSE. Maximum marks in Maths, Physics and Chemistry is 140 whereas maximum marks in English. IP and Biology is 180.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74a421dc37e0b41b5faf571bf7523388406c35a8f8d3d739cffee855af5662b5.png] 

What is percentage marks obtained by Rida in PCM (Maths, Physics and Chemistry)?
solution:
**Given:**

Maximum marks in Maths, Physics, and Chemistry = 140 each

Marks obtained by Rida in Maths = 70

Marks obtained by Rida in Physics = 110

Marks obtained by Rida in Chemistry = 120

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Marks = (Marks obtained/Maximum marks) × 100

**Calculation:**

Total marks obtained by Rida in PCM = 70 + 110 + 120 = 300

Total maximum marks in PCM = 140 × 3 = 420

Percentage Marks = (300/420) × 100

⇒ Percentage Marks = 71.43%

**The percentage of marks obtained by Rida in PCM is 71.43%.**
